citations.claim: first violating step cart outside track (|x|>2.4)
step before violation still inside track, showing crossing
approaching limit with negative velocity trend

counterfactual.change: Changed initial x from -0.2402 to 0.0 (single field) - eliminates initial offset so controller can keep cart within track for full 223 steps

explanation: Shrunk scenario starts with cart offset x=-0.24 and negative pole angular rate omega=-0.22, pole upright. With sensor_noise 0, controller applies small positive force (~0.65N) but insufficient to arrest drift; cart velocity becomes increasingly negative (v=-1.34 at step 220, -1.38 at 223) and position exceeds track limit -2.4 at step 223 (x=-2.419). Counterfactual resetting initial x to 0 with identical other parameters stays in track for same 223 steps, confirming initial offset/velocity bias causes failure.

violation.detail: cart at x=-2.419 outside the +/-2.4 track

vision_note: From frames 220 to 223 the blue cart drifts incrementally leftward while the pole remains near upright with only a slight lean. At frame 223 the cart is positioned at the left boundary of the track, visually consistent with exceeding the |x| <= 2.4 limit.
